reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread. The main contact for the duplicate arrivals on door 6 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**, their Director of Yard Operations.

The source is a message Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025. Marcus is in that channel, so he can see it himself. In it, Dana said Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. The cause was that the same trailer got two rows: the driver checked in at the kiosk, and then dispatch added him by hand. Dana owns the account and said she'd look into it, so I pointed Marcus to her on our side.

I didn't find a later update on this issue in the channels or files Marcus can see.
